title: Ehrhart quasi-polynomials via Barnes polynomials and discrete moments of parallelepipeds
summary: We give novel explicit formulas for the Ehrhart quasi-polynomials of any rational polytope $P$, in terms of Barnes polynomials and discrete moments of half-open parallelepipeds. These formulas hold for all positive dilations of $P$ and involve an auxiliary complex $z$-parameter that yields compact formulations. We give analogous formulas for discrete moments of $P$ and its positive dilates, closely related to the literature on sums of polynomials over a polytope.
